Du bist der offizielle KI-Kurations-Assistent für das autodocs Dokumentations- und Spezifikationssystem (AUTOSAR & S-Core).
Deine Aufgabe ist es, präzise, fachlich fundierte Erklärungen, User Guides und Diagramme zu verfassen.

FOLGENDE RICHTLINIEN SIND STRIKT BINDEND:
# Richtlinien für KI-generierte Erklärungen

Diese Datei ist Teil des Kuratierungsprozesses: Sie enthält die inhaltlichen
Leitplanken für alle KI-generierten Texte und Diagramme. Die maschinenlesbaren
Parameter dazu stehen in `ai/policy.json`; beide werden von
`ai_workflow.py auftrag` wörtlich in jeden Regenerierungsauftrag eingebettet.
Änderungen an Policy oder Richtlinien ⇒ `version` in `policy.json` erhöhen;
`ai_workflow.py status` zeigt dann, welche Fragmente noch mit einer älteren
Version erzeugt wurden.

## Geltungsbereich und Sprache

- Kanonische Sprache ist Deutsch (`site.json → sprachen.kanonisch`). KI-Inhalte
  werden ausschließlich deutsch erzeugt; die Übersetzung ist ein nachgelagerter
  Schritt (i18n_*.py) und niemals Teil der Generierung.
- API-Bezeichner, Typnamen, Enum-Werte, Code und `[SWS_…]`-Kennungen bleiben
  in jeder Sprache unverändert.

## Strukturelle Invarianten

- Jedes Fragment ist genau ein `<div class="ai …">` (Varianten: `ai` für
  Abschnitte, `ai usage` für Verwendungshinweise an Records, `ai module-guide`
  für Modul-Leitfäden) mit Badge und abschließender `<p class="ai-note">`
  (KI-Hinweis). Bestehende Fragmente sind die Referenz.
- Fragmente liegen unter `content/ai/<seiten-verzeichnis>/` und heißen
  `rec_<ELEMENT-ID>_<NN>.html` (an ein Spezifikationselement gebunden) oder
  `main_<NN>.html` (seitenbezogen).

## Belegpflicht und Quellen

- Jede fachliche Aussage ist mit `[SWS_…]`/`[RS_…]`-Zitat zu belegen
  (`policy.zitierpflicht`); Zitate verlinken auf das Quelldokument (PDF mit
  `#nameddest`), Richtwert `policy.relevanz.min_zitate_je_absatz`.
- Es dürfen nur Dokumente aus dem Quellenregister `ai/quellen.json` verwendet
  werden. Neue Quellen werden zuerst dort registriert (id, titel, typ, url).
- Aus Quellen extrahierte Einzelaussagen, auf die sich ein Text stützt, werden
  in der Trace unter `wissen[]` festgehalten: `{"aussage": …, "quelle": <id>,
  "fundstelle": …}`.

## Annahmen (Wissenslücken)

- Wo die Spezifikation schweigt, darf die KI Lücken mit Annahmen schließen —
  höchstens `policy.annahmen.budget_je_text` pro Text bzw.
  `budget_je_diagramm` pro Diagramm.
- Jede Annahme wird (a) im Text als Interpretation erkennbar formuliert und
  (b) in der Trace unter `annahmen[]` protokolliert:
  `{"annahme": …, "begruendung": …}`.
- Reicht das Budget nicht, wird der Aspekt weggelassen — niemals unmarkiert
  spekuliert.

## Diagramm-Entscheidung

Ein Diagramm wird nur eingefügt, wenn es gegenüber dem Text Mehrwert bietet
(`policy.diagramme`):

- Sequenzdiagramm (`.seq.json`): Abläufe mit ≥ `sequenz_ab_schritten`
  Schritten oder nicht offensichtlicher Reihenfolge/Asynchronität.
- Kontext-/Strukturdiagramm (`.dot`): ≥ `kontext_ab_beteiligten` beteiligte
  Komponenten oder nicht-triviale Vererbungs-/Abhängigkeitscluster.
- Zustandsdiagramm (`.dot`): Lebenszyklen und Zustandsmaschinen.
- Keine Trivialdiagramme (einzelne Aufrufe, Getter/Setter, Zweierbeziehungen).

Die Entscheidung („warum dieses Diagramm, warum diese Form“), etwaige
Annahmen und das Denk-Transkript zur Quellenerstellung gehören in die Trace
unter `diagramme["<quellpfad>"]` — nicht ins HTML. Diagrammquellen liegen als
`<fragment-stem>.<diag-id>.dot|.seq.json` neben dem Fragment (inline) bzw.
unter `diagrams/` (seitenweite Diagramme); gerendert wird mit
`render_diagrams.py`. Beschriftungen deutsch, Bezeichner unverändert.

      "source_page": 26,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Figure 7.1: State Machine for a\nSoftware Cluster\nThe state machine in Fig. 7.1 describes the life-cycle states of a\nSoftware Cluster\n.\nThese states are reported with\nGetSwClusterChangeInfo\nmethod.\n[SWS_UCM_00191]\nSoftware Cluster\nlife-cycle state\nkAdded\n⌈\nA\nSoftware\nCluster\nstate shall be\nkAdded\nafter the\nSoftware Cluster\nis successfully pro-\ncessed with\nProcessSwPackage\nmethod call on the\nAUTOSAR Adaptive Plat-\nform\nand if it was not previously present in the\nAUTOSAR Adaptive Platform\nand\nbefore activation is finished.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00011)\n[SWS_UCM_00192]\nSoftware Cluster\nlife-cycle state transition from\nkAdded\nto\nkPresent\n⌈\nA\nSoftware Cluster\nstate shall change from\nkAdded\nto\nkPre-\nsent\nafter a successful activation of a newly added\nSoftware Cluster\nwith\nFinish\nmethod call.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00011)\n[SWS_UCM_00195]\nSoftware Cluster\nlife-cycle state\nkUpdated\n⌈\nA\nSoftware\nCluster\nstate shall be\nkUpdated\nafter a successful processing of the updated\nSoft-\nware Cluster\nwith\nProcessSwPackage\nmethod call and before activation is fin-\nished.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00011)\n[SWS_UCM_00193]\nSoftware Cluster\nlife-cycle state transition from\nkUp-\ndated\nto\nkPresent\n⌈\nA\nSoftware Cluster\nstate shall change from\nkUpdated\nto\nkPresent\nafter a successful activation of the updated\nSoftware Cluster\nwith\nFinish\nmethod call, or after reverting the\nSoftware Cluster\nupdate with a\nRe-\nvertProcessedSwPackage\nmethod call.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00011)\n26 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_ucm_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_U_P27_49",
      "source_element": "SWS_UCM_00196",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement",
      "source_page": 27,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\n[SWS_UCM_00196]\nSoftware Cluster\nlife-cycle state\nkRemoved\n⌈\nA\nSoftware\nCluster\nstate shall be\nkRemoved\nafter successful completion of method\nProcessS-\nwPackage\nwhich involves the removal of the existed\nSoftware Cluster\nand before\nactivation is finished.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00011)\n[SWS_UCM_00194]\nSoftware Cluster\nlife-cycle state transition from\nkRe-\nmoved\nto\nkPresent\nin case of\nRevertProcessedSwPackages\ncall\n⌈\nA\nSoftware\nCluster\nstate shall change from\nkRemoved\nto\nkPresent\nafter a successful call to\nRevertProcessedSwPackages\nmethod in case the\nSoftware Cluster\nwas pre-\nviously requested to be removed by\nProcessSwPackage\nmethod call.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_-\n00011)\n[SWS_UCM_00286]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nSoftware Cluster\nlife-cycle state transition from\nkRemoved\nto\nkPresent\nin case of\nFinish\ncall\n⌈\nA\nSoftware Cluster\nstate shall\nchange from\nkRemoved\nto\nkPresent\nafter a successful call to\nFinish\nmethod in case\na\nSoftware Cluster\nbeing removed has to be rolled back after a failing activation.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00011)\n[SWS_UCM_00197] End of\nSoftware Cluster\nlife-cycle state from state\nkAdded\nin case of\nRevertProcessedSwPackages\ncall\n⌈\nA\nSoftware Cluster\nshall reach the end of its life-cycle from\nkAdded\nafter a successful removal of a\nnewly added\nSoftware Cluster\nwith\nRevertProcessedSwPackages\nmethod call\nin case the\nSoftware Cluster\nwas previously requested to be added by\nPro-\ncessSwPackage\nmethod call.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00011)\n[SWS_UCM_00287]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nEnd of\nSoftware Cluster\nlife-cycle state from\nstate\nkAdded\nin case of\nFinish\ncall\n⌈\nA\nSoftware Cluster\nshall reach the end\nof its life-cycle from\nkAdded\nafter a successful removal of a newly added\nSoftware\nCluster\nwith\nFinish\nmethod call in case the newly added\nSoftware Cluster\nhas\nto be rolled back after a failing activation.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00011)\n[SWS_UCM_00198] End of\nSoftware Cluster\nlife-cycle state from state\nkRe-\nmoved\n⌈\nA\nSoftware Cluster\nshall reach the end of its life-cycle if it is successfully\nremoved with a\nFinish\nmethod call and the\nSoftware Cluster\nis in state\nkRe-\nmoved\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00011)\n[SWS_UCM_00199] Reporting of\nSoftware Cluster\nreaching end of life-cycle\n⌈\nAny\nSoftware Cluster\nreaching the end of its life-cycle shall not be reported by\nUCM\nany more.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00011)\n7.1.2 Technical Overview\nOne of the declared goals of\nAUTOSAR Adaptive Platform\nis the ability to flexibly\nupdate the software and its configuration through over-the-air updates. During the life-\ncycle of an\nAUTOSAR Adaptive Platform\n,\nUCM\nis responsible to perform software\nmodifications on the machine and to retain consistency of the whole system.\n27 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"

      "id": "SNIP_ucm_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_U_P29_50",
      "source_element": "SWS_UCM_00122",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement",
      "source_page": 29,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\n•\nSoftware Package\ntransfer: A phase in which, one or several\nSoftware\nPackages\nare transferred from the\nUCM\n's Client Application to the internal buffer\nof the\nUCM\n. For further information see chapter 7.1.3.\n•\nSoftware Package\nprocessing: A phase in which the\nUCM\nperforms the oper-\nation (\nkInstall\n,\nkUpdate\n,\nkRemove\n) on the relevant\nSoftwareCluster\n. For\nfurther information see chapter 7.1.5.\n•\nActivation: A phase in which the\nUCM\nchecks the dependencies of the\nSoft-\nwareCluster\ns that have been involved in the operation, then activates them\nand finally check that all the\nSoftwareCluster\ns can be executed properly (via\nState Management\n) prior to finishing the update. For further information see\nchapter 7.1.6\n7.1.2.1.1 Software Package\n[SWS_UCM_00122]\nSoftware Package\nutilization\n⌈\nThe unit for deployment that\nthe\nUCM\nshall take as input is called\nSoftware Package\n, see [1].       "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\n[SWS_UCM_00184]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nPersistent data clean-up after Software Cluster re-\nmoval\n⌈\nUCM\nshall remove persistent data of a removed\nSoftwareCluster\nby ag-\ngregating the information given in the application manifest, namely PersistencyKeyVal-\nueStorage.uri and PersistencyFileStorage.uri, in order to leave the\nAUTOSAR Adap-\ntive Platform\nand the file system clean.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00026, RS_UCM_00017,\nRS_UCM_00004)\nFor more details, please refer to [SWS_PER_00397] in Persistency Specification [11].\n[SWS_UCM_00273]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nPersistent data clean-up after Software Cluster up-\ndate that removes a process\n⌈\nUCM\nshall remove persistent data of a removed pro-\ncess by aggregating the information given in the execution manifest, namely Per-\nsistencyKeyValueStorage.uri and PersistencyFileStorage.uri, in order to leave the\nAUTOSAR Adaptive Platform\nand the file system clean.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00026, RS_-\nUCM_00017, RS_UCM_00004)\nPersistent data can include administrative and backup data.\n7.1.2.2 Runtime dependencies\nProcesses within a\nSoftwareCluster\ncan have functional dependencies toward\nother\nSoftwareCluster\ns.\nDependencies are described in the\nSoftwareCluster\nmetamodel, see [9].\n[SWS_UCM_00120]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nRuntime dependencies check\n⌈\nUCM\nshall check run-\ntime dependencies before the activation of the new software version. This action is\ndone in the context of\nActivate\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00007)\nThe rationale is, if\nUCM\nhas to process several\nSoftware Packages\n, then execu-\ntion dependencies may not be fulfilled at all times during the\nSoftware Packages\nprocess but must be fulfilled before changes can be activated.\n7.1.2.3 Update scope and State Management\nSoftware Package\nprocessed by\nUCM\ncan contain\nAdaptive Applications\n, up-\ndates to\nAUTOSAR Adaptive Platform\nitself or to the underlying OS.       "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\nDefinition of an updatable state with respect to the system setup is the OEM respon-\nsibility. Based on the system setup and the application, the system might need to be\nswitched into a predefined state, to free resource to speed up the update, to block nor-\nmal usage of software which might cause interruptions to update process and to block\nusing functionality which might be interrupted by the update sequence.\n[SWS_UCM_00257]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nUpdate session\n⌈\nTo confirm the system is in an up-\ndatable state,\nUCM\nshall start an update session by calling\nState Management\nUpdateRequest\nService Interface\nRequestUpdateSession\nmethod after its de-\npendency check triggered by\nActivate\nmethod call.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00026, RS_UCM_-\n00003)\n[SWS_UCM_00258]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nUpdate session rejected\n⌈\nIf\nState Management\nUpdateRequest\nService Interface\nRequestUpdateSession\nmethod call raises er-\nror\nkRejected\n,\nUCM\nshall transition from\nkActivating\nto\nkReady\nstates and\nAc-\ntivate\nmethod call shall return\nApplicationError UpdateSessionRejected\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00026, RS_UCM_00024)\nIf update session could be recurrently rejected, it is up to implementer to cache the\ndependency check result in order to avoid unnecessary computation and compute it\nonly once.\nDuring the update session, the minimum applications required for the Update process\nshould be executed. This way system is more robust, more resources are free and\nuser is blocked from using applications, of which failure could cause safety risk to the\nuser.\nUpdate of some components require a Machine reset to be performed. These com-\nponents should be configured to be part of\nFunction Group MachineFG\n, as the\nupdate sequence of\nFunction Group MachineFG\nincludes a\nMachine\nreset.\nEx-\necution Management\n,\nState Management\n,\nCommunication Management\nand\nUCM\nitself are good examples which probably require a Machine reset to activate the up-\ndate. Other such components could be applications involved in the update sequence\nor applications involved in safety monitoring. Further details on\nFunction Group\nMachineFG\ncan be found in\nState Management\n.\n7.1.3 Transferring Software Packages\nTo speed up the overall data transmission time, the package transfer is decoupled\nfrom the processing and activation process. This section describes requirements for\ninitiation of a data transfer, the data transmission and ending of the data transmission.\nEach\nSoftware Package\ngets its own state as soon as it is being transferred to\nUCM\n.\nThe state machines in Fig. 7.4 specify the lifecycle of a\nSoftware Package\nthat is\ntransferred to and processed by\nUCM\n. During this lifecycle, a\nSoftware Package\nis\nuniquely identified with an\nid\nthat\nUCM\nprovides to the client.\n33 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"

      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\n[SWS_UCM_00088] Preparation of data transfer\n⌈\nData transfer shall be prepared\nwith the method\nTransferStart\n. In the preparation step the number of bytes to\nbe transferred is provided by the client and\nUCM\nassigns an\nid\nfor the\nSoftware\nPackage\nto be transferred.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00013, RS_UCM_00019, RS_UCM_00025)\nWhile a\nSoftware Package\nis being transferred, if\nUCM\nreceives a subsequent\nTransferStart\ncall targeting another\nSoftware Package\n,\nUCM\nshould make sure\nthat the sum of the size of both\nSoftware Package\ns (the one being transferred and\nthe one requested to be transferred) does not exceed the size of the\nUCM\nbuffer. each subsequent block.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00013, RS_UCM_00019,\nRS_UCM_00025)\n[SWS_UCM_00010] End of data transfer\n⌈\nAfter transmission of a\nSoftware Pack-\nage\nis completed, the transmission can be finished with method\nTransferExit\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00013, RS_UCM_00019, RS_UCM_00025)\n[SWS_UCM_00028]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nSoftware Package\nAuthentication\n⌈\nUCM\nshall\ncheck authentication of the\nSoftware Package\nor the transferred block before pro-\ncessing it.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00006)\nSoftware Package\ncontains authentication and integrity tags, which are used during\nthe transfer sequence to authenticate the content of the\nSoftware Package\n.\n[SWS_UCM_00075] Multiple data transfers in parallel\n⌈\nHandling of multiple data\ntransfers in parallel shall be supported by\nUCM\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00019)\nIf\nUCM\nprovide enough buffering resources for\nSoftware Packages\n, several pack-\nages could be transferred (in parallel) before they are processed one after the store that\nSoftware Package\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00018)\n[SWS_UCM_00069] Report information on\nSoftware Packages\n⌈\nUCM\nshall pro-\nvide a method\nGetSwPackages\nof the interface       "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\n[SWS_UCM_00166] Processing from stream state\n⌈\nIf UCM supports processing\nfrom stream and is in state\nkIdle\nor\nkReady\n, the method\nProcessSwPackage\nfor a\nSoftware Package\nin state\nkTransferring\nshall set this\nSoftware Package\nto\nstate\nkProcessingStream\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00024, RS_UCM_00025)\n[SWS_UCM_00167]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nCancelling streamed packages\n⌈\nAll temporary and\nprocessed data of a\nSoftware Package\nin state\nkProcessingStream\nshall be re-\nmoved if\nCancel\nis called.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00020, RS_UCM_00025)\n[SWS_UCM_00168] Transferring while processing from stream\n⌈\nSoftware\nPackage\nstate shall remain in\nkProcessingStream\nwhen\nTransferData\nis\ncalled.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00024, RS_UCM_00025)\n[SWS_UCM_00169] Finishing transfer while processing from stream\n⌈\nSoftware\nPackage\nstate shall be set to\nkProcessed\nwhen\nTransferExit\nis called and the\nSoftware Package\nis completely processed.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00024, RS_UCM_00025)\n[SWS_UCM_00200]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nFailing authentication\n⌈\nUCM\nshall delete the\nSoft-\nware Package\nand its related data processed by\nProcessSwPackage\ncall if authen-\ntication is failing at\nTransferExit\nor\nProcessSwPackage\ncall.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00039,\nRS_UCM_00006)\n7.1.5 Processing Software Packages\nIn contrast to package transmission, only one\nSoftware Package\ncan be processed\nat the same time to ensure consistency of the system. In the following, a software\nor package processing can involve any combination of an installation, update or re-\nmoval of applications, configuration data, calibration data or manifests. It is up to the\nvendor-specific metadata inside a\nSoftware Package\nto describe the tasks\nUCM\nhas\nto perform for its processing. For a removal, this might involve metadata describing\nwhich data needs to be deleted. Nevertheless, the communication sequence between\nthe triggering application of the software modification and\nUCM\nis the same in any case.\nFor an update of an existing application, the\nSoftware Package\ncan contain only\npartial data, e.g. just an updated version of the execution manifest.       "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\n[SWS_UCM_00107] Activated state\n⌈\nUCM\nstate\nkActivated\nshall express that new\nversion of updated\nSoftwareCluster\ns are verified.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00008, RS_UCM_-\n00030)\nThe state management [3] on the level of execution is handled by the\nUCM\n's client\ncontrolling the update process.\nUCM\nhas to be able to update several\nSoftwareCluster\ns for an update campaign.\nHowever, these\nSoftwareCluster\ns could have dependencies not satisfied if updates\nare processed and activated one by one. Therefore,\nUCM\nsplits the activation action\nfrom the general package processing.\n[SWS_UCM_00027] Delta Package activation\n⌈\nApplicable version of\nSoft-\nwareCluster\non which to apply delta shall be included into related\nSoftwarePack-\nage\n's deltaPackageApplicableVersion attribute.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00007)\n[SWS_UCM_00025] Activation of\nSoftwareCluster\ns\n⌈\nUCM\nshall offer method\nAc-\ntivate\nto enable execution of any pending changes from the previously processed\nSoftware Packages\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00021)\nAfter\nActivate\n, the new set of\nSoftwareCluster\ns can be started. Activation covers\nall the processed\nSoftware Packages\nfor all the clients.\n[SWS_UCM_00022] Shared Activation of\nSoftware Packages\n⌈\nUCM\nshall acti-\nvate all the processed\nSoftware Packages\nwhen\nActivate\nis called.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_-\n00021)\nThe activation method could lead to a full system reset. When\nSoftware Package\nupdates underlying OS,\nAUTOSAR Adaptive Platform\nor any\nAdaptive Appli-\ncation\nwhich is configured to be part of\nFunction Group MachineFG\n, the execu-\ntion of updated software occurs through system reset by calling\nState Management\nUpdateRequest\nService Interface\nResetMachine\nmethod. Meta-data of\nSoftware\nPackage\ndefines the activation method.\nIn principle, it is possible to activate multiple versions of the same\nSoftwareCluster\nin one activation step. This could be useful for example with delta package updates\nbut does not apply to firmware updates. The specification does not prohibit to create\nthis kind of chained updates. The decision to use chained updates should be based on\nsafety aspects and the applicability of the underlying update technology, if the update\nis for a classic or an adaptive platform, if a file system is involved or if the used platform\neven support it.\n7.1.6.1.1 Error handling for\nActivate\n[SWS_UCM_00281]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nActivate\nerror handling order\n⌈\nActivate\nmethod\nshall check the following error conditions and return the respective error code.\n1. [SWS_UCM_00238]\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00008)\n[SWS_UCM_00239]\nRollback\nOperationNotPermitted\n⌈\nRollback shall raise the er-\nror\nApplicationError OperationNotPermitted\nin case\nUCM\ncurrent state is not\nkActivated\nnor\nkVerifying\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00020)\n[SWS_UCM_00238]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nRollback\nNotAbleToRollback\n⌈\nRollback shall raise\nthe error\nApplicationError NotAbleToRollback\nin case failure has occurred\nduring Rollback.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00020)\n7.1.6.3 Boot options\nDuring update process the executed software is switched from original software to\nupdated software and in case of rollback, from updated software to original version.\nWhich version of software is executed is dependent on the\nUCM\nstate and this is man-\naged by the\nUCM\n. In case of platform and OS update the switch between software\nversions occurs through system reset and depending on the system design the Exe-\ncution Management [2] might be started before\nUCM\n. In this case there can't be direct\ninterface between\nUCM\nand Execution Management [2] to define which versions of soft-\nware would be executed. Instead this would be controlled through persistent controls\nwhich are referred as\nBoot options\nin this document.\n[SWS_UCM_00094] Management of executable software\n⌈\nUCM\nshall manage which\nversion of software is available for the Execution Management [2] to launch.\n⌋\n(RS_-\nUCM_00021)\nDuring the\nkActivating\nstate,\nUCM\nmodifies the\nBoot options\nso that in the next\nrestart for the updated software the new versions will be executed. In the\nkRolling-\nBack\nstate,\nUCM\nmodifies the\nBoot options\nso that in the next restart of the updated\nsoftware the original versions will be executed.\n7.1.6.4 Finishing activation\n[SWS_UCM_00020] Finishing the packages activation\n⌈\nUCM\nshall provide a method\nFinish\nto commit all the changes and clean up all temporary data of the processed\nSoftware Packages.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00015)\n47 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"

      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\nUCM\nshould also remove\nSoftware Packages\n, logs or any older versions of changed\nsoftware to save storage space. It is up to implementer to remove or not the\nSoftware\nPackages\n.\n[SWS_UCM_00259] Ending the update session\n⌈\nUCM\nshall call\nState Manage-\nment UpdateRequest\nService Interface\nStopUpdateSession\nmethod when\nUCM\nis\nexiting the\nkCleaningUp\nstate.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00021, RS_UCM_00018)\n[SWS_UCM_00240]\nFinish\nOperationNotPermitted\n⌈\nFinish shall raise the error\nApplicationError OperationNotPermitted\nin case there are no activated nor\nrolled-back\nSoftware Packages\npending finalization (i.e\nUCM\nstate is not\nkActi-\nvated\nnor\nkRolledBack\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00001, RS_UCM_00026)\nFor\nUCM\nto be able to free all unneeded resources while processing the\nFinish\nre-\nquest, it is up to the vendor and platform specific implementation to make sure that\nobsolete versions of changed\nSoftwareCluster\ns aren't executed anymore.\n7.1.7 Status Reporting\nOnce\nSoftware Packages\nare transferred to\nUCM\n, they are ready to be processed\nto finally apply changes to the\nAUTOSAR Adaptive Platform\n. In contrast to the\ntransmission, the processing and activation tasks have to happen in a strict sequential\norder.\nTo give an overview of the update sequence, the global state of\nUCM\nis described in\nthis section. The details of the processing and activation phases and the methods are\nspecified in the 7.1.5 and 7.1.6.\nThe global state of\nUCM\ncan be queried using the field\nCurrentStatus\n. The state\nmachine for\nCurrentStatus\nis shown in Fig. 7.5. This diagram does not include\nbehaviour after a reset. Examples can be found of how\nUCM\nand its\nCurrentStatus\nfield behave including reset management in chapter 10 Sequence Diagram.\n[SWS_UCM_00019] Status Field of Package Management\n⌈\nThe global state of\nUCM\nshall be provided using the field\nCurrentStatus\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00024)\n48 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"

      "verbatim_text": "Figure 7.5: State Machine for the package processing using service interface:\nPackage-\nManagement\nUCM\nsupported method calls for each value of field\nCurrentStatus\nare shown in Fig.\n7.5.\n[SWS_UCM_00086]\n⌊\nOBSOLETE\ng\nUnsupported method calls\n⌈\nUnsupported\nmethod calls shall raise the\nApplicationError OperationNotPermitted\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00024)\n[SWS_UCM_00080] Idle state of Package Management\n⌈\nkIdle\nshall be the default\nstate.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00024)\n[SWS_UCM_00149] Return to the Idle state from Processing state\n⌈\nkIdle\nstate\nshall be set when\nProcessSwPackage\nreturns with error code\nProcessSwPackage-\nCancelled\nand if no other\nSoftware Packages\nwere previously processed during\nthis processing operation.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00024)\n[SWS_UCM_00151] Entering the Ready state of Package Management after a\nCancel call\n⌈\nIf\nProcessSwPackage\nhas been cancelled, it shall return error code\nProcessSwPackageCancelled\nand set state to\nkReady\nonly if at least one other\nSoftware Package\nwas previously processed during this processing operation.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00024)\n49 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"

      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\n[SWS_UCM_00081] Processing state of Package Management\n⌈\nkProcessing\nstate shall be set only if\nProcessSwPackage\nhas been called. This shall only be\npossible, if\nCurrentStatus\nis reported as\nkIdle\nor\nkReady\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00024)\n[SWS_UCM_00266]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nOperationNotPermitted error and UCM state\n⌈\nUCM\nshall return\nApplicationError OperationNotPermitted\nif\nProcessSwPack-\nage\nis called by a client with\nUCM\nat\nCurrentStatus\nstate different than\nkIdle\n,\nkProcessing\nor\nkReady\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00001, RS_UCM_00004, RS_UCM_00005)\n[SWS_UCM_00083] Entering the Ready state of Package Management after a\nsuccessful processing operation\n⌈\nkReady\nstate shall be set after a\nSoftware\nPackage\nprocessing has been completed successfully.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00024)\n[SWS_UCM_00265]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nstate transition due to\nProcessSwPackage\nerror\n⌈\nIf\nProcessSwPackage\nraises an\nApplicationError\nother than\nProcessSwPack-\nageCancelled\n, it shall transition from\nkProcessing\nto\nkIdle\nif no other Software\nPackages were previously processed during this processing operation, or\nkReady\nif\nat least one other Software Package was previously processed before the failed pro-\ncessing operation, and shall perform clean-up actions.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00015, RS_UCM_-\n00026)\nClean-up actions could be similar to the cancel call by for instance deleting files, folders\nor artefacts of the processed\nSoftware Cluster\n.\n[SWS_UCM_00152] Entering the Ready state of Package Management after a\nmissing dependency\n⌈\nkReady\nstate shall be set when\nActivate\nfails due to an\nApplicationError MissingDependencies\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00024)\n[SWS_UCM_00084] Entering the kActivating state of Package Management\n⌈\nkActivating\nshall be set when\nActivate\nis called. This triggers the dependency\ncheck and returns\nApplicationError MissingDependencies\nif this check fails.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00024)\n[SWS_UCM_00153] Action in kActivating state of Package Management\n⌈\nWhen\nkActivating\nis set and after the\nState Management UpdateRequest\nService In-\nterface\nRequestUpdateSession\nmethod call by\nUCM\n, the\nUCM\nshall call the\nState\nManagement UpdateRequest\nService Interface\nPrepareUpdate\nmethod for the\nconcerned\nSoftware Cluster\nincluding a list of all\nFunction Groups\nbelonging\nto that\nSoftware Cluster\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00024)\n[SWS_UCM_00260]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nPrepareUpdate, VerifyUpdate and PrepareRollback\norders\n⌈\nUCM\nshall compute the order of the\nState Management UpdateRequest\nService Interface\nPrepareUpdate\n,\nVerifyUpdate\nand\nPrepareRollback\nmethod\ncalls from the dependency model included in the\nSoftware Cluster\nmanifests.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00007, RS_UCM_00021, RS_UCM_00030)\n[SWS_UCM_00261] PrepareUpdate, VerifyUpdate and PrepareRollback syn-\nchronous calls\n⌈\nCalls to\nState Management UpdateRequest\nService Interface\nPrepareUpdate\n,\nVerifyUpdate\nand\nPrepareRollback\nmethods shall not be\nconcurrent.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00026)\n50 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"

      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\n[SWS_UCM_00262]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nUpdate preparation rejected\n⌈\nIf any one of the\nState\nManagement UpdateRequest\nService Interface\nPrepareUpdate\nmethod call re-\nturns error\nkRejected\ntoo many times or for too long (implementation specific thresh-\nolds),\nUCM\nshall transition from\nkActivating\nto\nkReady\nstates.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00026)\n[SWS_UCM_00263] Update preparation failure\n⌈\nIf any one of the\nState Man-\nagement UpdateRequest\nService Interface\nPrepareUpdate\nmethod returns error\nkPrepareFailed\n,\nUCM\nshall transition from\nkActivating\nto\nkReady\nstates.\n⌋\n(RS_-\nUCM_00026)\n[SWS_UCM_00154]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nEntering the Verifying state of Package Manage-\nment\n⌈\nkVerifying\nshall be set when the dependency check have been performed\nsuccessfully (all dependencies are satisfied) and that the preparation of the\nSoft-\nware Clusters\nby the\nState Management\nhas been successfully performed.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00024)\nThe machine could most likely be restarted in case a A/B partition is used. In case\nthe A/B partition is not used, all affected\nFunction Groups\nor the platform could be\nrestarted. Immediately after the processed\nSoftware Package\nhas been restarted,\na system check has to be performed in order to make sure the machine is able to start\nup as expected. With this check it is verified that other safety relevant software like\nFunctional Cluster Platform Health Manager\n[12] is running and user can\nbe protected from any issues caused by the update after the update has finished.\nAn update could most likely require to reparse the manifests after performing the\natomic activation of the\nSoftware Clusters\n(switching A/B partition, changing sym-\nlinks, etc.) if a machine reset is not needed.\n[SWS_UCM_00085]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nEntering the kActivated state of Package Manage-\nment\n⌈\nkActivated\nstate shall be set when the machine or all impacted\nFunction\nGroups\n(the ones related to the processed\nSoftware Package\n) have been suc-\ncessfully restarted and verified indicated by successful return of\nState Management\nUpdateRequest\nService Interface\nVerifyUpdate\nmethod calls.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00024)\nkVerifying\nstate gives the client controlling the update process a chance to perform\nverification test by calling\nState Management UpdateRequest\nService Interface\n[SWS_SM_91017]\nVerifyUpdate\nmethod, though functionality in verify state can\nbe limited. Client can also coordinate the results over several\nAUTOSAR Adaptive\nPlatforms\nand still perform a\nRollback\nif verification indicates the need for it.\nIf the system check is successful, the client can decide either to\nRollback\nthe current\nactive processing so that the previous processed working software gets started, or to\nperform\nFinish\nso that the changes of processed software become permanent. By\ncalling\nFinish\na clean-up is initiated and in case of A/B partition, a swap between\nthe partitions happens and the newly inactive partition becomes a copy of the newly\nactive partition. In case\nFinish\nsucceeds (including the clean-up), the current\nCur-\nrentStatus\nchanges to\nkIdle\n.\nFor\nRollback\nthe update software needs to be deactivated and possibly reactivated\nfrom original version, e.g. self-update of\nUCM\n. For this reason\nRollback\nis also\n51 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"

      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\nperformed through two states, similarly as activation. This is started by\ncalling\nState Management UpdateRequest\nService Interface [SWS_SM_91017]\nPrepareRollback\nmethod for each\nSoftware Cluster\n. On success,\nUCM\ngoes to\nkRollingBack\nstate. In this state all the changes introduced during update process\nhave been deactivated and can be cleaned by calling\nFinish\n.\n[SWS_UCM_00126] Entering the\nkRollingBack\nstate after a Rollback call\n⌈\nThe\nstate\nkRollingBack\nshall be set when\nRollback\nis called.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00008, RS_-\nUCM_00030)\n[SWS_UCM_00155]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nEntering the kRolling-Back state after a failure in\nthe kVerifying state\n⌈\nThe state\nkRollingBack\nshall be set if any of the\nState Man-\nagement UpdateRequest\nService Interface\nVerifyUpdate\nmethod calls returns\nthe result\nkVerifyFailed\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00008, RS_UCM_00030)\n[SWS_UCM_00264]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nUpdate verification rejected\n⌈\nIf any one of the\nState\nManagement UpdateRequest\nService Interface\nVerifyUpdate\nreturns error\nkRe-\njected\ntoo many times or for too long (implementation specific thresholds),\nUCM\nshall\ntransition to\nkRollingBack\nstate.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00030, RS_UCM_00008)\n[SWS_UCM_00111]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nEntering the\nkRollingBack\nstate\n⌈\nThe state\nkRollingBack\nshall be set after all calls to\nState Management UpdateRequest\nService Interface\nPrepareRollback\nhave returned successfully.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00008,\nRS_UCM_00030)\n[SWS_UCM_00146] Entering the Cleaning-up state after a Finish call\n⌈\nThe state\nkCleaningUp\nshall be set when\nFinish\nis called and the\nUCM\nstarts to perform\ncleanup actions.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00008, RS_UCM_00030)\n[SWS_UCM_00162] Entering the Cleaning-up state after a\nRevertProcessedSw-\nPackages\ncall\n⌈\nThe state\nkCleaningUp\nshall be set when\nRevertProcessedSw-\nPackages\nis called in\nkProcessing\nor\nkReady\nstates and the\nUCM\nstarts to perform\ncleanup actions.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00008, RS_UCM_00030)\n[SWS_UCM_00163] Action in Cleaning-up state\n⌈\nWhen\nkCleaningUp\nstate is set,\nthe\nUCM\nshall clean up all data of the processed packages that are not needed any-\nmore.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00008, RS_UCM_00030)\n[SWS_UCM_00164] Cleaning up of Software Packages\n⌈\nIn\nkCleaningUp\nstate, the\nUCM\nmay remove (from the UCM buffer for instance) the \"physical\" Software Package\n(e.g. zip file) that was used to transport the the SoftwareCluster to the\nUCM\n.\n⌋\n(RS_-\nUCM_00008, RS_UCM_00030)\n[SWS_UCM_00127] Finishing update sequence\n⌈\nkIdle\nshall be set when\nFinish\nis called and the clean-up has been successfully performed. This finishes the update\nsequence and next sequence can be started.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00008, RS_UCM_00030)\n52 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"

      "source_page": 53,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\n[SWS_UCM_00147] Return to the Idle state from Cleaning-up state\n⌈\nkIdle\nstate\nshall be set when the Clean-up operation has been completed successfully.\n⌋\n(RS_-\nUCM_00024)\n7.1.8 Robustness against reset\nFailure during over-the-air updates could lead into corrupted or inconsistent software\nconfiguration and further updates might be blocked. For this reason\nUCM\nneeds to be\nrobust against interruptions like power downs.\n[SWS_UCM_00157] Detection of reset\n⌈\nAt start up\nUCM\nshall identify if uncontrolled\nreset occurred.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00027)\nThe way for\nUCM\nto detect uncontrolled reset is project specific.\nUCM\ncould use hard-\nware platform specific registers to detect Soft/Hard reset. Or it could access PHM\nFunctional Cluster to detect uncontrolled reset.\nUCM\ncould also check that the\nCur-\nrentStatus\npersistent field is not\nkIdle\nor\nkVerifying\n.\n[SWS_UCM_00158] Cleanup of interrupted actions\n⌈\nAfter an uncontrolled reset,\nUCM\nshall check non volatile memory integrity, recover processed artifacts in case it\nis corrupted and resume interrupted actions in order to return the system into a state\nfrom where\nUCM\ncan continue serving its Clients.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00027)\n[SWS_UCM_00270]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nUCM internal state persistency\n⌈\nUCM\nshall persist\nCurrentStatus\nstate field to be able to resume on-going update after an intended or\nunintended reboot.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00027)\n7.1.8.1 Boot monitoring\nActivation failure during OS and Platform-self updates can lead to a state in which the\nsystem is not able to reach a point where\nUCM\nand the client are able to function as\nexpected and thus not able to execute the rollback. For these cases the system should\ninclude component which is responsible to monitor that the OS and platform will start\nup correctly. In case of failure, the Boot monitoring component should trigger a reset\nor modify the boot options to trigger a rollback.\n7.1.9 History\n[SWS_UCM_00115] History\n⌈\nGetHistory\nmethod shall retrieve all actions that have\nbeen performed by\nUCM\nwithin a specific time window input parameter.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_-\n00032)\n53 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"

      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\nIn the case the\nUCM\nClient requests a rollback after a successful activation,\nCur-\nrentStatus\nfield transitioning to\nkActivated\n,\nGetHistory\nmethod will later re-\nturn\nGetHistoryType\n, with subelement\nResolution\nof type\nResultType\nequal to\nkActivatedAndRolledBack\n.\n[SWS_UCM_00160] Processing results records\n⌈\nUCM\nshall save activation time and\nactivation result of processed\nSoftware Packages\nin the history.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00032)\n[SWS_UCM_00271]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nKeeping history of failure error code\n⌈\nUCM\nshall keep\nin\nGetHistoryType\nsubelement\nFailureError\nthe last failure error code as de-\nscribed in [SWS_UCM_00136]. If no error occurred, the stored value shall be 0.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00032)\n7.1.10 Version Reporting\n[SWS_UCM_00004] Report software information\n⌈\nUCM\nshall provide a method\nGetSwClusterInfo\nof the interface service\nPackageManagement\nto provide the\nidentifiers and versions of the\nSoftwareCluster\ns that are in state\nkPresent\n.\n⌋\n(RS_-\nUCM_00002)\n[SWS_UCM_00030] Report changes\n⌈\nUCM\nshall provide a method\nGetSwCluster-\nChangeInfo\nof the interface service\nPackageManagement\nto provide the identifiers\nand versions of the\nSoftwareCluster\nthat are in state\nkAdded\n,\nkUpdated\nor\nkRe-\nmoved\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00011)\n[SWS_UCM_00185] Provide\nSoftwareCluster\ngeneral information\n⌈\nUCM\nshall\nprovide a method\nGetSwClusterDescription\nto return the version, type approval,\nlicense and release notes of the\nSoftwareCluster\nthat are in state\nkPresent\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00002, RS_UCM_00011)\n7.1.11 Securing Software Updates\nUCM\nprovides service interface using\nara::com\n. There is no authentication of the\nclient in\nUCM\n's update sequence.\nFor authentication of the\nSoftware Package\n, you can refer to 7.1.3\n[SWS_UCM_00103]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nUpdate to older\nSoftware Cluster\nversion than\ncurrently present\n⌈\nIn order to avoid an attacker to install an old\nSoftware Cluster\nversion having known security flaws,\nUCM\nshall prohibit its processing. In case of such\nattempt,\nUCM TransferExit\nor\nTransferData\nshall raise the\nApplicationError\nOldVersion\n, keep within history this attempt and delete old\nSoftware Package\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00031)\n54 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"

      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\n[SWS_UCM_CONSTR_00002]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nUCM confidential information handling\n⌈\nThe\nPackageManagement\ninterface shall only be mapped via\nara::com\nto a se-\ncure endpoint using secure communication channel providing confidentiality protec-\ntion.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00002, RS_UCM_00010, RS_UCM_00011)\nThe GetSwClusterInfo, GetSwClusterChangeInfo, GetHistory, GetSwClusterDescrip-\ntion and GetSwPackages methods are using data that could identify vehicle user and\ntherefore should be protected for confidentiality.\n[SWS_UCM_00202]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nTrusted Platform compliance\n⌈\nUCM\nshall ensure that\nafter provisioning updates, all the necessary changes to maintain the Trusted Platform\nare carried out.\n⌋\n(RS_EM_00014)\nThe authentication tag of the Trusted Platform corresponding to the updated/re-\nmoved/added executable files should also be updated/removed/added. See also Chap-\nter 7.10 of the Execution Management [2] for details on the Trusted Platform.\n7.1.12 Functional cluster lifecycle\n[SWS_UCM_00274]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nUCM\ninitialization\n⌈\nUCM\nshall offer its services only after\nits internal initialization has been completed, after switching to Running state.\n⌋\n(RS_-\nUCM_00044)\nThis requirement prevents calling\nUCM\nsubordinate API while internal initialization is\non-going. The concrete initialization tasks are implementation specific.\n7.1.12.1 Shutdown behaviour\nThere are no requirements of shutdown behaviour from\nUCM\nfunctional cluster.\n55 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"

      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\n7.2 UCM Master\n7.2.1 UCM Master Functional Cluster lifecycle\n[SWS_UCM_01205]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nUCM Master\ninternal state persistency\n⌈\nUCM Mas-\nter\nshall persist its state to be able to resume on-going update campaign after an\nintended or unintended reboot.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035, RS_UCM_00042)\n[SWS_UCM_01019]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nUCM Master\ninitialization\n⌈\nUCM Master\nshall offer\nits services only after its internal initialization has been completed, after switching to\nRunning state.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00044)\nThis requirement prevents calling\nUCM Master\nAPI while internal initialization is on-\ngoing. The concrete initialization tasks are implementation specific.\n7.2.2 Technical Overview\nUCM Master\nobjective is to provide a standard Adaptive Autosar solution to safely and\nsecurely update a complete vehicle Over The Air or by a Diagnostic Tester.\nUCM Master\nreceives packages from\nBackend\nor Diagnostic tool, parses and inter-\nprets the\nVehicle Package\n, transfers or streams\nSoftware Packages\nto suitable\ntargets (\nUCM\nsubordinate or Diagnostic Application) and orchestrates the processing,\nactivations and eventual rollbacks. All these actions are what is called a campaign\nwhich\nUCM Master\nis coordinating. The\nUCM\nof the machines in the same network of\na\nUCM Master\n, candidates target of a campaign, are referred to as\nUCM\nsubordinates."

      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\nThe\nUCM Master\ncould be considered as a set of add-on features that could enrich\nany\nUCM\ninstance. Therefore, as per the\nUCM\nAPIs, the\nUCM Master\nAPIs are part of\nthe\nAdaptive Platform Services\n.\nUCM\nand\nUCM Master\nhave separate service\ninstances.\nThe\nOTA Client\nestablishes a communication between\nBackend\nand\nUCM Master\nso that they can exchange information of the installed\nSoftware Clusters\nin the\nvehicle and the\nSoftware Clusters\navailable in the\nBackend\n. This communica-\ntion could be triggered by\nOTA Client\nwith a scheduler and\nUCM Master\nto request\nthe updates in case of newly available\nSoftware Clusters\n(pull case) or by\nBack-\nend\nto push, for instance, an important security update to a fleet of vehicles (push\ncase). The computation to find new\nSoftware Clusters\nversions and resolution of\ndependencies between\nSoftware Clusters\ncan be either done at\nUCM Master\nor\nBackend\n.\nVehicle Driver interface\nAdaptive Application\nis required if it is needed during an\nupdate campaign to interact with vehicle human driver through for instance Human-\nMachine Interface. Download of packages from a\nBackend\ncould have various finan-\ncial costs for the driver depending of communication types, so consent from driver\ncould be suitable.\nVehicle State Manager Adaptive Application\nis required if it is needed dur-\ning an update campaign to control the vehicle state for safety purposes. For instance, it\ncould be required for safety to have standing still vehicle, shut-off engine, closed doors,\netc. before starting an\nUCM\nactivation or during its processing.\n7.2.3 UCM Master general behaviour\nThe\nUCM Master\nacts as a client of the service interface offered by the\nUCM\nsubor-\ndinates, already specified in\nUCM\n. However, the\nUCM Master\nalso offers three differ-\nent service interfaces to\nOTA Client\n, Vehicle Driver interface and\nVehicle State\nManager\nrespectively.\nUCM Master\naggregates\nUCM\nsubordinates states and can re-\nport its status field to a\nBackend\nthrough its\nOTA Client\n.\nA\nUCM Master\nreceives a\nVehicle Package\nand transfers or streams\nSoftware\nPackage\n(s) to the\nUCM\nsubordinates for an\nAUTOSAR Adaptive Platform Soft-\nware Cluster\nupdate. A\nVehicle Package\ncontains instructions for orchestrating\nupdates between\nECUs\n. The\nUCM Master\nprovides information about\nECUs\nin the\nvehicle, installed software and update campaign resolution.\n[SWS_UCM_01003]\nUCM Master\nchecks states of\nUCM\nsubordinates\n⌈\nA\nUCM\nMaster\nshall check the status of its\nUCM\nsubordinates are all at\nkIdle CurrentSta-\ntus\nstate before starting a campaign.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00043)\nUCM Master\nshould for instance make sure that there is no ongoing diagnostic up-\ndates before starting an update campaign by checking the reported state(s) of the\nUCM\nsubordinate(s) to be idle.\n57 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"

      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\n[SWS_UCM_01014] Packages transferring sequence\n⌈\nTransferStart\nmethod\nshall raise the\nApplicationError UnexpectedPackage\nif the\nSoftware Pack-\nage\nname parameter was not a value of the\nRequestedPackage\nfield.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_-\n00043)\n[SWS_UCM_01013] Too big block size received by\nUCM Master\n⌈\nIn the case the\nreceived block size with\nTransferData\nexceeds the block size returned by\nTrans-\nferStart\nor\nTransferVehiclePackage\nfor the same TransferId,\nUCM Master\nshall raise the\nApplicationError IncorrectBlockSize\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035)\n[SWS_UCM_01015] Invalid Vehicle Package manifest\n⌈\nTransferExit\nshall raise\nthe\nApplicationError InvalidPackageManifest\nwhen a\nVehicle Package\nmanifest is not compliant with the AUTOSAR schema.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00036, RS_UCM_-\n00043)\n[SWS_UCM_01016] Invalid Package Manifest\n⌈\nUCM Master\nshall raise the\nAppli-\ncationError InvalidPackageManifest\nin case a manifest file is not compliant\nwith the AUTOSAR schema.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00036, RS_UCM_00043)\n[SWS_UCM_01017] RequestedPackage field\n⌈\nUCM Master\nshall provide the field\nRequestedPackage\ncontaining the requested\nSoftware Package\nname and ver-\nsion as defined in update campaign. Changing this field is a notification for the\nOTA\nClient\nto start transfer of the requested\nSoftware Package\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00042)\nOTA Client\ndoes not know what\nSoftware Packages\nshould be transferred in a\ngiven campaign contained in a\nVehicle Package\n.\nOTA Client\ncan know what\nSoftware Package\nis expected to be transferred by subscribing to\nUCM Master\n's\nRequestedPackage\nfield. Version is added to support campaigns which need an up-\ndate path for a\nSoftware Package\nrequiring an intermediate update to a transitional\nversion. In this case the version parameter makes it unambiguous which package\nversion shall be transferred as both have the same name assigned.\n7.2.6 Adaptive Applications interacting with UCM Master\nIn order to have interoperability between several vendors platforms,\nAdaptive Ap-\nplications\ninteracting with\nUCM Master\nvia ara::com like\nOTA Client\n,\nVehicle\nState Manager\nor Vehicle Driver Interface have their APIs specified.       "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\nand packages to the vehicle by identifying the vehicle, by for instance sending VIN to\nBackend\n.\nOTA Client\nuses the\nUCM Master\nas a service provider via ara::com. Since trans-\nferring\nVehicle Packages\nand\nSoftware Packages\nfrom\nBackend\nto\nUCM Mas-\nter\nis\nOTA Client\n's responsibility,\nOTA Client\nshould be able to accommodate any\nproprietary communication protocol used between\nOTA Client\nand\nBackend\nand\nconvert it into ara::com transport protocol.\nOTA Client\nshould support\nUCM Master\nSoftware Packages\ntransfer or streaming as specified in chapter 7.2.5, it should\nthen provide at least the following functionality:\n•\nComply to the requirements of chapter 7.1.3 in the context of package transfer\nbetween\nOTA Client\nand\nUCM Master\n.\n•\nOTA Client\nshould subscribe to\nUCM Master\n's\nRequestedPackage\nfield to\nknow what\nSoftware Package\nis expected to be transferred\n•\nOTA Client\nshould subscribe to\nUCM Master\n's\nTransferState\nfield to know\nwhat is campaign state\n•\nOTA Client\nshould subscribe to\nUCM Master\n's\nSafetyState\nfield to eventu-\nally make sure vehicle is in a safe state before transferring Packages\n•\nOTA Client\ncould support multiple data transfers in parallel, as specified in\n[SWS_UCM_00075]\nIn addition,\nOTA Client\ncould support the ability to pause or resume the package\ntransfer for the current campaign to prioritize the transfer of the packages from a dif-\nferent campaign. The ability of\nOTA Client\nto pause or resume the package transfer\nmight be helpful in the case there is a need to cancel an ongoing campaign at\nkTrans-\nferring\nstate to allow higher priority campaign to be performed.\nOnly one\nUCM Master\nhas to be used by\nOTA Client\ns per network domain. As\nUCM\nMaster\nis distributing\nSoftware Packages\nand coordinating\nUCM\nsubordinates,\nOTA\nClient\ns in the same network domain have to make sure there are no already on-going\ncampaigns when starting a new campaign with\nTransferVehiclePackage\nmethod\ncall by checking\nUCM Master\n's state with\nTransferState\nfield, in order to avoid any\ninterference and guarantee success of an update campaign.\n[SWS_UCM_01101] Provide information of installed\nSoftware Clusters\nin ve-\nhicle\n⌈\nUCM Master\nshall provide a method\nGetSwClusterInfo\nto return information\nof all\nSoftware Cluster\npresent in the vehicle.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00033)\nUCM Master\ncan aggregate\nSoftware Cluster\ninformation from several\nUCM\ns\nwithin a vehicle and returns the result to a\nBackend\nwhich can compute if there is any\nnew\nSoftware Cluster\navailable and decide to send to\nUCM Master\nthrough\nOTA\nClient\na\nVehicle Package\n. It is up to\nOTA Client\nto make sure the synchroni-\nsation of the versions of\nSoftware Packages\npresent in\nBackend\nand\nSoftware\nCluster\ns in the vehicles using\nGetSwClusterInfo\nor\nSwPackageInventory\nis\nrecent enough before starting a campaign with\nTransferVehiclePackage\ncall.\n60 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"

      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\n7.2.7 Non Adaptive Platform update\n[SWS_UCM_01121]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nAdaptive Platform interface provided for Flashing\nAdapter\n⌈\nThe interface provided by the\nAUTOSAR Adaptive Platform\nin order to\nupdate non AUTOSAR Platform should comply with ISO 22900-2:2017 (\nD-PDU API\n)\nbut as this standard's coverage is wide, it is allowed to implement a reduced API that is\nneeded to update for instance a\nAUTOSAR Classic Platform\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035)\nThe implementation of the\nD-PDU API\nis processing binary data from the Flashing\nAdapter and do all of the required session, transport and network layer handling to\nsend and receive the data on the physical vehicle bus with respect to the underlying\nprotocols. The reason of using ISO 22900-2:2017 is to ensure that the specific Flashing\nAdapter from any vehicle or tool manufacturer can operate on a common software\ninterface and can easily exchange\nMVCI\n(Modular Vehicle Communication Interface)\nprotocol module implementations.\nIn the case the targeted ECU by an update does not have the capability to switch\nbetween current and new\nSoftware Cluster\n, the vehicle package campaign should\nforesee to download not only the new version but also the currently installed version\nof the Software Cluster to be updated in order to make possible a rollback from the\nnew version to the old version of the\nSoftware Cluster\n. The location to store the\ncurrent\nSoftware Package\ncould be the Flashing Adapter but ultimately it has to be\navailable to Flashing Adapter in order to flash it in case of a rollback.\n7.2.7.1 D-PDU API implementation support\n[SWS_UCM_01122]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nSupported physical layers by\nD-PDU API\nimple-\nmentation\n⌈\nISO_11898_2_DWCAN (Dual Wire CAN), ISO_11898_3_DWFTCAN\n(Dual Wire CAN Fault tolerant), SAE_J2411_SWCAN (Single Wire CAN) and\nIEEE_802_3(Ethernet) physical layers shall be supported if their respective physical\nvehicle bus is available inside the ECU, all other physical layers present in\nD-PDU API\nare optional.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035)\n[SWS_UCM_01123]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nSupported application layers by\nD-PDU API\nimple-\nmentation\n⌈\nISO_15765_3 (Unified diagnostic services, UDS on CAN, ISO withdrawn\nUDS), ISO_14229_3 (Unified diagnostic services on CAN implementation, UDSon-\nCAN) and ISO_14229_5 (Unified diagnostic services on Internet Protocol implemen-\ntation, UDSonIP) application layers shall be supported if their respective application\nlayer is available inside the ECU, all other application layers present in\nD-PDU API\nare\noptional.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035)\n[SWS_UCM_01124]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nSupported protocols by\nD-PDU API\nimplementa-\ntion\n⌈\nISO UDS on CAN with Application layer ISO_15765_3, ISO UDS on CAN with\nApplication layer ISO_14229_3 (UDSonCAN) and ISO UDS on DoIP with Application\nlayer ISO_14229_5 (UDSonIP) protocols shall be supported, all other protocols are\noptional.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035)\n65 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"

If the\nuse case excludes frequent changes to the\nMDF\ns, simple Flashing Adapter may even\nhardcode (e.g. in a header file) all necessary IDs and operate the\nD-PDU API\nwithout\nsymbolic names.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035)\n[SWS_UCM_01129]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nSAE J2534-1 and RP 1210a compatibility\n⌈\nD-PDU\nAPI\nimplementation may not be compatible to SAE J2534-1 and RP 1210a.\n⌋\n(RS_-\nUCM_00035)\nThe Adaptive Platform does not need any migration path.\n[SWS_UCM_01130]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nComPrimitives in RawMode\n⌈\nD-PDU API\nimplemen-\ntation may not implement the IOCTL filter data structure.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035)\n7.2.7.3 Not required D-PDU API functions\nPDULockResource() and PDUUnlockResource() are used to lock and unlock exclusive\naccess to a ComLogicalLink in case of parallel usage of the\nD-PDU API\nimplemen-\ntation by multiple applications on the same physical communication link.       "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\na Classic ECU always requires some exclusive access and should be handled in the\nAUTOSAR Adaptive Platform\nitself.\n[SWS_UCM_01131]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nPDUIoCtl(PDU_IOCTL_RESET)\n⌈\nThe parame-\nter PDU_IOCTL_RESET may not be implemented in\nD-PDU API\nimplementa-\ntion so the call of PDUIoCtl(PDU_IOCTL_RESET) shall return the error code\nPDU_ERR_ID_NOT_SUPPORTED.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035)\n[SWS_UCM_01132]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nPDUIoCtl(PDU_IOCTL_START_MSG_FILTER),\nPDUIoCtl(PDU_IOCTL_CLEAR_MSG_FILTER), PDUIoCtl(\nPDU_IOCTL_STOP_MSG_FILTER)\n⌈\nThe call of PDUIoCtl() with the pa-\nrameters PDU_IOCTL_START_MSG, PDU_IOCTL_CLEAR_MSG_FILTER\nand PDU_IOCTL_CLEAR_MSG_FILTER shall return the error code\nPDU_ERR_ID_NOT_SUPPORTED.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035)\nThe parameters PDU_IOCTL_START_MSG, PDU_IOCTL_CLEAR_MSG_FILTER and\nPDU_IOCTL_CLEAR_MSG_FILTER are intended for the PassThru-Mode for com-\nprimitives and therefore an implementation is not required for the Flashing Adapter.\n[SWS_UCM_01133]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nPDUIoCtl(PDU_IOCTL_SEND_BREAK)\n⌈\nThe IOCTL command PDU_IOCTL_SEND_BREAK shall return\nPDU_ERR_ID_NOT_SUPPORTED.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035)\nThe IOCTL command PDU_IOCTL_SEND_BREAK is used to send a break signal on\nthe ComLogicalLink. A break signal can only be sent on certain physical layers (e.g.\nSAE J1850 VPW physical links and UART physical links) which are not supported by\nUCM\n.\n[SWS_UCM_01134]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nNot used\nD-PDU API\nfunction return codes\n⌈\nThe return codes PDU_ERR_CABLE_UNKNOWN, PDU_ERR_RSC_LOCKED,\nPDU_ERR_RSC_NOT_LOCKED, PDU_ERR_API_SW_OUT_OF_DATE and\nPDU_ERR_MODULE_FW_OUT_OF_DATE may not be implemented into the\nD-PDU API\nof the\nAUTOSAR Adaptive Platform\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035)\nThere is no cable attached to the ECU and therefore no cable detection return code\nPDU_ERR_CABLE_UNKNOWN could occur.\nLocking is not required for the Flashing Adapter, therefore PDU_ERR_RSC_LOCKED\nand PDU_ERR_RSC_NOT_LOCKED return code could not occur.\nThere is no separation of\nD-PDU API\n-Software with the\nMVCI\nprotocol module firmware required in the\nAUTOSAR Adap-\ntive Platform\n, so PDU_ERR_API_SW_OUT_OF_DATE and\nPDU_ERR_MODULE_FW_OUT_OF_DATE return codes could not occur.\n67 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"

      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\n[SWS_UCM_01266]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nSubordinate Not Available On The Network\n⌈\nUCM\nMaster\nshall record persistently the error SubordinateNotAvailableOnTheNetwork in\ncase one of the UCM subordinate involved in the current campaign stops offering its\nservice interface and later report it with\nGetCampaignHistory\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00034)\n[SWS_UCM_01267]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nVehicle State Manager Communication Error\n⌈\nUCM\nMaster\nshall record persistently the error VehicleStateManagerCommunicationError\nin case the communication with Vehicle State Manager is not possible and later report\nit with\nGetCampaignHistory\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00034)\n[SWS_UCM_01268]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nVehicle Driver Interface Communication Error\n⌈\nUCM\nMaster\nshall record persistently the error VehicleDriverInterfaceCommunicationError\nin case the communication with Vehicle Driver Interface is no longer possible and later\nreport it with\nGetCampaignHistory\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00034)\n[SWS_UCM_01269]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nCampaign cancellation history\n⌈\nIf\nCancelCampaign\nmethod is called,\nUCM Master\nshall record persistently this event to later report it with\nGetCampaignHistory\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00034)\n7.2.11 Content of Vehicle Package"

      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\n(waiting passively for next reboot) to get activated. To optimize a campaign or fulfil\ndependencies, it could be required to activate\nSoftware Clusters\none after the\nother or several at once. To support all possible campaigns, the\nVehicle Pack-\nage\nincludes a model describing this coordination. It also contains a way to identify\nthe several involved\nUCM\ns for packages distribution within the vehicle and potentially\noverwriting default\nUCM Master\nfor this specific campaign.\nYou can find below for information purpose a description of the information that must\nbe contained in Vehicle Package manifest:\n•\nRepository: uri, repository or diagnostic address, for history, tracking and security\npurposes\n•\nVehicle description: vehicle description\n•\nVehicle Driver notifications: it might be needed to ask vehicle driver if\nUCM Mas-\nter\ncan start transferring\nSoftware Packages\n, processing it and activating it\nbut also inform him of the necessary safety requirements if applicable.\n•\nSafety policy: safety policy index to be used as argument to subscribe a field to\nvehicle safety manager. With this field,\nUCM Master\nwill be informed at any time\nof campaign if vehicle safety is met or not.\n•\nUCM Master\nidentifiers list: defines backup\nUCM Master\ns\n•\nCampaign orchestration: You can refer to [9] for more details. This campaign\nmodel allows to group activation of several\nUCM\ns and group\nSoftware Pack-\nages\nprocessing and transferring.\n[SWS_UCM_01301]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nVehicle Package\nauthentication\n⌈\nVehicle\nPackage\nshall be authenticated by\nUCM Master\nbefore any transfer of\nSoftware\nPackages\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00039, RS_UCM_00043)\n[SWS_UCM_01302]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nVehicle Package\nauthentication failure\n⌈\nIn case\nVehicle Package\nauthentication fails at\nTransferExit\ncall,\nUCM Master\nshall\nraise the\nApplicationError AuthenticationFailed\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00039, RS_-\nUCM_00043)\n[SWS_UCM_01303]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nDependencies between\nSoftware Packages\n⌈\nUCM\nMaster\nshall check dependencies based on\nVehicle Package Manifest\ns and\nSoftware Packages Manifest\ns before an transfer of\nSoftware Packages\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035, RS_UCM_00043)\n[SWS_UCM_01305]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nVehicle Package\nformat\n⌈\nVehicle Package\nshall\ncontain\nVehicle Package\nmanifest and\nSoftware Packages\nmanifests of ARXML\nformat.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035, RS_UCM_00043)\n[SWS_UCM_01306]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nTransferExit\nInvalid package manifest\n⌈\nTrans-\nferExit\nshall raise the error\nApplicationErrorInvalidPackageManifest\nupon receive of an invalid manifest.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00012)\n76 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"

      "source_page": 77,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\n7.2.12 Vehicle update security and confidentiality\nThe methods\nGetSwClusterInfo\n,\nSwPackageInventory\nand\nGetHistory\ncould\nuse private or confidential information.\n[SWS_UCM_CONSTR_00013]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nConfidential information protection\n⌈\nThe\nVehiclePackageManagement\nand\nVehicleDriverApplication\ninterfaces shall\nonly be called over secure communication channel providing confidentiality protection.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00033)\nThe\nGetSwClusterInfo\n,\nSwPackageInventory\n,\nGetCampaignHistory\n,\nGetSwClusterChangeInfo\n,\nGetHistory\n,\nGetSwClusterDescription\nand\nGetSwPackages\nmethods are using data that could identify vehicle user and there-\nfore should be protected for confidentiality.\n77 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"

Als Interpretation gekennzeichnete Aussagen sind Schlussfolgerungen aus den Quellen.</p><h4>PackageManagement als Update-Grenze</h4><p><code>ara::ucm::PackageManagement</code> nimmt Software Packages entgegen, verarbeitet sie und steuert deren Aktivierung, Verifikation und gegebenenfalls Wiederherstellung. <code>CurrentStatus</code> macht die globale UCM-Phase beobachtbar. <a class="docref" href="https://www.autosar.org/fileadmin/standards/R25-11/AP/AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement.pdf#nameddest=chapter.7">SWS UCM Kapitel 7 „Functional specification“</a> <a class="swsref" href="https://www.autosar.org/fileadmin/standards/R25-11/AP/AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement.pdf#nameddest=SWS_UCM_00131">[SWS_UCM_00131]</a> <a class="swsref" href="https://www.autosar.org/fileadmin/standards/R25-11/AP/AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement.pdf#nameddest=SWS_UCM_00019">[SWS_UCM_00019]</a></p>
<h4>Transfer und Verarbeitung entkoppeln</h4><p>Ein Transfer beginnt mit <code>TransferStart</code>, dessen Rückgabewert die zulässige Blockgröße festlegt. <code>TransferData</code> überträgt die Blöcke, und <code>TransferExit</code> schließt den Transfer mit Vollständigkeits- und Formatprüfungen ab. Danach verarbeitet <code>ProcessSwPackage</code> das Paket; mehrere Transfers können von der sequenziellen Verarbeitung getrennt sein. <a class="docref" href="https://www.autosar.org/fileadmin/standards/R25-11/AP/AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement.pdf#nameddest=section.7.3">SWS UCM §7.3 „Transfer and processing“</a> <a class="swsref" href="https://www.autosar.org/fileadmin/standards/R25-11/AP/AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement.pdf#nameddest=SWS_UCM_00272">[SWS_UCM_00272]</a> <a class="swsref" href="https://www.autosar.org/fileadmin/standards/R25-11/AP/AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement.pdf#nameddest=SWS_UCM_00275">[SWS_UCM_00275]</a> <a class="swsref" href="https://www.autosar.org/fileadmin/standards/R25-11/AP/AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement.pdf#nameddest=SWS_UCM_00276">[SWS_UCM_00276]</a></p>

<h4>Aktivierung mit State Management</h4><p>Vor der Aktivierung werden Abhängigkeiten geprüft und eine Update-Session bei SM angefordert. UCM berechnet die Reihenfolge der Aufrufe <code>PrepareUpdate</code>, <code>VerifyUpdate</code> und <code>PrepareRollback</code>; diese Aufrufe dürfen nicht parallel erfolgen. Ein abgelehnter Session-Request führt zurück in die Vorbereitungsphase. <a class="swsref" href="https://www.autosar.org/fileadmin/standards/R25-11/AP/AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement.pdf#nameddest=SWS_UCM_00257">[SWS_UCM_00257]</a> <a class="swsref" href="https://www.autosar.org/fileadmin/standards/R25-11/AP/AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement.pdf#nameddest=SWS_UCM_00260">[SWS_UCM_00260]</a> <a class="swsref" href="https://www.autosar.org/fileadmin/standards/R25-11/AP/AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement.pdf#nameddest=SWS_UCM_00258">[SWS_UCM_00258]</a></p>

<h4>Rollback, Beobachtung und Fahrzeugkontext</h4><p>Rollback ist ein eigener Übergang mit definiertem Fehlausgang <code>kRollingBackFailed</code>; bei Erfolg folgen die vorgegebenen SM-Aufrufe zur Rückkehr in einen konsistenten Satz von Software Clustern. Die Vehicle-UCM-Spezifikation erweitert diesen Paket-orientierten Ablauf um die Fahrzeug- und Kampagnenperspektive, nicht um eine zweite lokale PackageManagement-Semantik. <a class="swsref" href="https://www.autosar.org/fileadmin/standards/R25-11/AP/AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement.pdf#nameddest=SWS_UCM_00300">[SWS_UCM_00300]</a> <a class="swsref" href="https://www.autosar.org/fileadmin/standards/R25-11/AP/AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement.pdf#nameddest=SWS_UCM_00301">[SWS_UCM_00301]</a> <a class="docref" href="https://www.autosar.org/fileadmin/standards/R25-11/AP/AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_VehicleUpdateAndConfigurationManagement.pdf#nameddest=chapter.7">SWS Vehicle UCM Kapitel 7 „Functional specification“</a></p>
<h4>Empfohlene Client-Reihenfolge</h4><ol><li>Transfer-ID und <code>blockSize</code> aus <code>TransferStart</code> übernehmen.</li><li>Blöcke mit monotonem <code>blockCounter</code> senden und erst danach <code>TransferExit</code> aufrufen.</li><li>Paket verarbeiten, Status prüfen und <code>Activate</code> nur aus der Vorbereitungsphase auslösen.</li><li>Nach Verifikation <code>Finish</code> oder bei Bedarf <code>Rollback</code> wählen.</li></ol><p class="ai-evidence">Weiterführende, aus dem bisherigen Block erhaltene Nachweise: <a class="swsref" Specification of Update and Configuration
Management
AUTOSAR AP R21-11
1 Introduction and functional overview
This software specification contains the functional description and interfaces of the
functional cluster
Update and Configuration Management
which belongs to the
AUTOSAR Adaptive Platform
Services.
Update and Configuration Man-
agement
has the responsibility of installing, updating and removing software on an
AUTOSAR Adaptive Platform
in a safe and secure way while not sacrificing the
dynamic nature of the
AUTOSAR Adaptive Platform
.
The
Update and Configuration Management
functional cluster is responsible
for:
•
Version reporting of the software present in the
AUTOSAR Adaptive Platform
•
Receiving and buffering software updates
•
Checking that enough resources are available to ensure a software update
•
Performing software updates and providing log messages and progress informa-
tion
•
Validating the outcome of a software update
•
Providing rollback functionality to restore a known functional state in case of fail-
ure
In addition to updating and changing software on the
AUTOSAR Adaptive Plat-
form
, the
Update and Configuration Management
is also responsible for up-
dates and changes to the
AUTOSAR Adaptive Platform
itself, including all func-
tional clusters, the underlying POSIX OS and its kernel with the responsibilities defined
above.
In order to allow flexibility in how
Update and Configuration Management
is
used, it will expose its functionality via ara::com service interfaces, not direct APIs.
This ensures that the user of the functional cluster
Update and Configuration
Management
does not have to be located on the same ECU.

is the ability to flexibly
update the software and its configuration through over-the-air updates. During the life-

,
UCM
is responsible to perform software
modifications on the machine and to retain consistency of the whole system.

7.1.3 Transferring Software Packages
To speed up the overall data transmission time, the package transfer is decoupled
from the processing and activation process. This section describes requirements for
initiation of a data transfer, the data transmission and ending of the data transmission.
Each
Software Package
gets its own state as soon as it is being transferred to
UCM
.
The state machines in Fig. 7.4 specify the lifecycle of a
Software Package
that is
transferred to and processed by
UCM
. During this lifecycle, a
Software Package
is
uniquely identified with an
id
that
UCM
provides to the client.

7.1.5 Processing Software Packages
In contrast to package transmission, only one
Software Package
can be processed
at the same time to ensure consistency of the system. In the following, a software
or package processing can involve any combination of an installation, update or re-
moval of applications, configuration data, calibration data or manifests. It is up to the
vendor-specific metadata inside a
Software Package
to describe the tasks
UCM
has
to perform for its processing. For a removal, this might involve metadata describing
which data needs to be deleted. Nevertheless, the communication sequence between
the triggering application of the software modification and
UCM
is the same in any case.
For an update of an existing application, the
Software Package
can contain only
partial data, e.g. just an updated version of the execution manifest. Any
UCM
Client
need to confirm that
UCM
is in
kIdle CurrentStatus
state before starting any up-
date (process/activate).

ter

vehicle safety manager. With this field,
UCM Master
will be informed at any time
of campaign if vehicle safety is met or not.

UCM Master
identifiers list: defines backup
UCM Master
s
•
Campaign orchestration: You can refer to [9] for more details. This campaign
model allows to group activation of several
UCM
s and group
Software Pack-
ages
processing and transferring.
